text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — automated cost alert flagged Stonebridge: they've consumed ~47% of their monthly token allocation in the first 9 days. Noticed heavy embedding calls from onboarding flow. Thinking we should triage before their monthly health check. Who can do a quick forecast and suggest mitigations? :eyes:

devon_finops: I can run a 30/60/90 forecast. Quick numbers from billing: current month usage = 470k tokens, monthly cap = 1M tokens, daily avg last 3 days = 52k. If trend continues, projected month = ~1.56M (over by 56%).

oliver_ae: yikes. renewal risk increases if they hit overage. Do we know which endpoints are hot? embeddings vs generation mix?

maria_cs: embeddings are ~65% of calls, mostly in onboarding pipeline for user-vectoring. Also some high-temp generation tests from their staging account.

sam_engineer: I can add short-term throttles and advise on batching embeddings. Two quick levers: 1) group rapid-fire embed calls into a bulk batch; 2) enable prefix/KV caching for known onboarding prompts.

devon_finops: Agreed. Also recommend switching embedding model to the more cost-efficient embedding-compact for ephemeral vectors (we can present cost delta in the health check).

maria_cs: Can we set an immediate budget alert that notifies both customer and our CS lead at 80% and 95%? Prefer Slack + email.

sam_engineer: I can push a temporary alert policy. Patch snippet for the webhook config I’ll apply: ```json
{
  "alert_name": "stonebridge_monthly_budget",
  "thresholds": [80, 95],
  "notify_channels": ["#customer-success", "stonebridge-owner@example.com"],
  "escalation": ["maria_cs", "devon_finops"]
}
```

infra-bot: New policy draft saved to infra/configs/alerts/stonebridge_monthly_budget.json by sam_engineer.

devon_finops: Also adding a quick sensitivity run: if embeddings drop 30% via batching + compact model, projected month becomes ~980k (within cap). I'll attach a tiny table in the health doc.

oliver_ae: Great. For the renewal conversation, we should surface: 1) projected overage amounts at current trend; 2) quick-win mitigations and estimated savings; 3) enablement plan to reduce embed churn.

maria_cs: Can we schedule a 30-min enablement session with their eng lead this week? Suggest Wed 11am PT. @oliver_ae can you lead the call?

oliver_ae: I can. Please invite Stonebridge engineering (cc: lead@stonebridge.ai). I'll prepare a short 10-min demo on batching + token budgeting.

sam_engineer: I'll attach the runbook link in the calendar invite and enable the 80% alert now. One ask: we might need a temporary rate-limit rule. @devon_finops can you approve conservative throttles for the staging key?

devon_finops: Approved for staging key only. Production throttles require customer sign-off.

maria_cs: Noted. I'll message the account and propose the Wednesday slot and mention temporary staging throttles to prevent surprise bills.
deploy-bot: deploy successful: alert-webhook v1.2.3 → prod (sam_engineer). :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Action items recap: 1) devon to attach sensitivity table to health doc (due EOD today) 2) sam to enable 80% alert + attach runbook (in next 45m) 3) oliver to lead enablement call Wed 11am PT (invite sent) 4) maria to notify Stonebridge + surface production throttle requirement.

oliver_ae: I'll also bring sample cost comparisons (compact vs standard embedding) and a short slide on caching ROI.

maria_cs: Thanks team. If we can get the sensitivity table and runbook in, I'll fold into the account health brief before the call. :raised_hands:
